workflow_ops.py:305-309 emits single_turn/agent_tier filtered by `included` (probe-scoped) but det_gated=gate_log (populated by route_criteria which 'has no probe notion', per production_batch_runner.py:256-258)

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test through `ProductionBatchRunner`/`_project_criteria` asserting the leaf gate applies without emitting a second `det_gated` record (the assemble-step record is the sole one).
evidence: production_batch_runner.py:265 `single, agent = route_criteria(ctx)` — the caller updated for the new signature, with docstring at :261-264 asserting 'No gate_log is passed ... skips are captured once, at the assemble step'

ABSENCE: `search_files('_project_criteria')` returns no hit in tests/unit/plan_review/test_det_criterion_gates.py; every gate test drives `orchestrator.route_criteria` directly or `plan_review_assemble_criteria` (test lines 57, 226-237), never ProductionBatchRunner._project_criteria
ABSENCE: `search_files('det_gated')` shows no assertion that the batch-runner/project fan-in path produces no duplicate det_gated record
advisory.finding: The `production_batch_runner._project_criteria` change (a scope file in this diff) introduces a new behavioral contract — its `route_criteria(ctx)` call now runs the new leaf-gate block and deliberately passes NO gate_log so removal-rationale/asserted-capability skips are 'captured once' at the assemble step and not duplicated — but no test exercises this path. Neither the 'no duplicate det_gated record' claim nor 'project fan-in still routes correctly with the leaf gate active' is verified.
scenarios: A future change records a gate_log inside _project_criteria (duplicating the assemble record) — undetected
The new leaf-gate block wrongly sheds a project-relevant criterion in the batch-runner fan-in path
advisory.suggested_fix: Add a route test that calls `production_batch_runner._project_criteria(ctx, exclude=set())` on both a vocabulary-absent and a vocabulary-present ticket, asserting the routed project subset is unaffected by the new leaf gate and that no gate_log is populated on that path.

Approach text: 'the table values migrate to DetGateRule objects (the four existing entries T5a/T5d/T7/T12 become one-element text_all rules...)' scoped to registry.py
advisory.finding: The DetGateRule dataclass, both rule tables (_DET_OVERLAY_RULES / _DET_LEAF_GATE_RULES), and the overlay_triggers/leaf_gate_triggers functions were placed in a NEW module src/rebar/llm/plan_review/det_gate_rules.py that is not among the files enumerated in the ticket's Scope; the Scope and Approach both direct this code to live in registry.py ('DetGateRule + rule tables + migration' against src/rebar/llm/plan_review/registry.py), so introducing a new source file exceeds the authorized file set.

advisory.suggested_fix: Amend the ticket Scope to explicitly list det_gate_rules.py as a new file with the 800-LOC-cap justification (a formal Scope edit, not only a comment), or relocate the DetGateRule/tables into registry.py per the enumerated scope.

dropped.finding: The only route-level positive test that a fired plan routes (`test_route_criteria_fired_plans_route_unchanged`) co-mixes all four criteria's vocabularies into a single plan.
